caption: This drawing features a vertically oriented black weathervane design sketched on an off-white background. The weathervane consists of a central vertical rod with decorative scrollwork at the top and bottom. At the top section of the rod are two pairs of outward-curving branches, each topped with letters "N" and "W" indicating the cardinal directions North and West. Near the upper end of the rod is an elongated arrow with a trident-shaped point facing left and a rectangular fletching on the right end, rendered with dense parallel lines to suggest texture. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, simplified version of the same design inside a rectangle with dimension lines labeled "9" vertically and "1’ 3”" horizontally. The artist's signature and date are present in small text at the lower right corner of the sheet. The entire drawing is executed in black pencil or ink with fine lines and some shading, particularly on the arrow's fletching.
title: Weather Vane
